name: ULAANBAATAR 3D data

sources.layer: boundary, districts, roads, rail, water, vegetation, trees, transit, places, buildings
sources.includes: OpenStreetMap contributors; Microsoft ML Building Footprints; Google/Microsoft combined buildings (doi:10.5281/zenodo.8174931); Overture places (Meta, Microsoft)
sources.licence: ODbL 1.0 (OSM-derived), CDLA-Permissive-2.0, CC BY 4.0 depending on theme
sources.accuracy: Volunteer and machine-learned mapping, not survey-verified. OSM in central Ulaanbaatar is usually within a few metres; ML footprints can be offset or merged.

sources.source: AWS Terrain Tiles (Tilezen), terrarium encoding, zoom 14
sources.accuracy: About 30 m ground resolution, vertical error several metres; a surface model in parts (roofs and trees can be included).

unknown: Building heights: missing for most buildings in every open source (see buildings tileset extras).
Cadastral parcels (NSDI Mongolia / ALAGaC): not reachable from the build machine, import pipeline only.
Orthophotos at sub-metre resolution: not openly licensed for redistribution; viewer streams imagery providers live instead of copying them.
